title: Prove admission journeys on the delivered candidate
text: Source tests and UI fixtures cover personal approval, teammate redemption, Team and token recovery; they do not prove deployment. The hosted Team consumer requires compatibility proof against each exact engine candidate. Still owed: production delivery evidence, published-wheel installation and production Browser proof of Machines, Team and Profile at desktop and narrow widths in both themes. Keep failures and reruns tied to the candidate. The eight own-machine, teammate-invite, company-sign-in and local-refusal cases in human and agent presentations now exist in source at campaign positions 30-37, on the installed candidate's own disposable server (fixture.machine-admission-prepare), a human-only gate (operator_gate human_action) and a real-state proof; source tests pass them against the real server, routes and CLI, but they have not yet run on Test Machines against a released candidate, so that execution with the person's own steps is still owed. The original 29 campaign cases stay unchanged and the agent-to-TUI invite handoff stays private. Hosted mirror retirement is implemented in source after authorized consumer and zero-pending evidence. Permanent secret-receipt cleanup has recorded fleet rehearsal evidence, including scoped operator exceptions; rehearsal is not proof that every production history entry ran.
